maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost row consists of four distinct spots aligned roughly parallel to the denser row below, with a vertical separation of approximately two spot-widths and a slight increase in inter-spot distance towards the posterior.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Melanin-saturated pixels cover approximately 98% of the visible rhinarium, showing a nearly uniform dark surface with no significant pink depigmentation visible.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: A strictly lateral view shows a continuous contour with a shallow concave depression between the supraorbital ridge and the nasal bridge, sloping at an angle of approximately 32 degrees.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notch on the posterior margin of the ear pinna; several small, high-contrast dark spots on the muzzle area that may represent healed puncture scars.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct transition to dense black/dark brown mane hair immediately posterior to the ear and along the ventral neck line.
